integrity: The conditional law is independently reconstructed by the rooted-forest decomposition of a functional digraph. The permutation factorial moments are counted directly, and the cyclic-point tail distribution is derived from exact mapping enumeration. The packaged checker exhaustively verifies all mappings through n=6.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the classical uniform random mapping and uses the uniform permutation law on the cyclic set.
The conditional cyclic-set decomposition is classical; the claimed contribution is the exact threshold reduction of mixed factorial moments and the fixed-point orthogonality phenomenon.
Older random-mapping monographs and generating-function literature may contain equivalent identities implicitly.
title: Random-mapping cycle counts see cyclic mass only through feasibility thresholds
